item.title: Leaked documents detail ECHOTRIBBLE, a nascent US Army Cyber Command program for agentic AI to autonomously spread across networks to find and eliminate targets (Sam Biddle/The Intercept)
item.description:
Sam Biddle / The Intercept:
Leaked documents detail ECHOTRIBBLE, a nascent US Army Cyber Command program for agentic AI to autonomously spread across networks to find and eliminate targets  —  Documents obtained by The Intercept show the military is trying to deploy autonomous AI agents to hack its adversaries.

Original (direct link): https://theintercept.com/2026/10/19/army-autonomous-ai-agents-arcyber/

item.title: Chinese robovan maker Neolix raised a $400M Series E led by Boyu, taking total funding to $1.4B+; it operates 30K+ vehicles in 300+ cities across 20 countries (Saritha Rai/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Saritha Rai / Bloomberg:
Chinese robovan maker Neolix raised a $400M Series E led by Boyu, taking total funding to $1.4B+; it operates 30K+ vehicles in 300+ cities across 20 countries  —  Neolix Technologies Co., a Chinese maker of driverless delivery vehicles, raised $400 million to fuel its global expansion.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-20/alibaba-backs-chinese-robovan-maker-in-400-million-fundraising

item.title: An Australian minister says the eSafety Commissioner plans to sue Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube over alleged breaches of the under-16 social media ban (Angus Whitley/Bloomberg)
item.description:

item.title: Mercury CEO Immad Akhund says the fintech hit $1B in annualized revenue, up ~50% YoY, has more than 450K customers, and is launching a payroll service (Eric Newcomer/Newcomer)
item.description:
Eric Newcomer / Newcomer:
Mercury CEO Immad Akhund says the fintech hit $1B in annualized revenue, up ~50% YoY, has more than 450K customers, and is launching a payroll service  —  I sat down with Mercury CEO Immad Akhund  —  We just published my conversation with Mercury CEO Immad Akhund on the Newcomer Podcast.

item.title: Sources: Ted Sarandos complained for months of a lack of new Netflix hit shows and US watch time being down; Netflix just fired its film chief and content chief (Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Wall Street Journal:
Sources: Ted Sarandos complained for months of a lack of new Netflix hit shows and US watch time being down; Netflix just fired its film chief and content chief  —  Company is overhauling creative leadership as it struggles to get domestic audiences to watch more  —  Netflix is writing a new script.

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/business/media/netflix-americas-dominant-streaming-service-has-hit-a-wall-13660401?st=pHTpM3&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink

item.title: Sources: Waymo aims to expand its fleet to 8K by the end of this year, up from 4K today, and to 20K by the end of 2027, after raising $5B in debt this month (Ellen DiMauro/Semafor)
item.description:
Ellen DiMauro / Semafor:
Sources: Waymo aims to expand its fleet to 8K by the end of this year, up from 4K today, and to 20K by the end of 2027, after raising $5B in debt this month  —  THE SCOOP  —  As Waymo expands into new cities with its self-driving cars, the company plans to use the $5 billion it recently borrowed to massively increase its fleet.

Original (direct link): https://www.semafor.com/article/10/19/2026/waymo-plans-to-quintuple-its-fleet

item.title: Cloudflare debuts Clairic, a System One-class extraction model it says processes unstructured data faster, more cheaply, and more accurately than normal LLMs (Cloudflare)

Cloudflare debuts Clairic, a System One-class extraction model it says processes unstructured data faster, more cheaply, and more accurately than normal LLMs  —  Today, we're announcing a preview of a new class of System One-style models: extraction models.
